images.caption:
Along with the British and the French, the Americans obtained the right to establish a concession in Tientsin in 1860 and a sector was delineated (red rectangle). The concession operated more or less formally until 1880 and was eventually absorbed into the British concession. Vague residual rights remained.


After the German concession was terminated in 1917, the U.S. Army's 15th Infantry Regiment stationed in Tientsin moved its headquarters to the former German barracks (red circle) where it remained until 1938.
